name: handcraft
title: Handcraft Kit
responsibility: In-repo crafted primitives (grain, dots, corner ticks, sheen, editorial type, SectionShell/SectionHead, ordinals). Carries the design DNA so presets feel made by hand, not generated.

upstream.notice: Not vendored — authored here. handcraft/handcraft.tsx is the canonical copy; presets sync byte-identical copies into src/components/primitives/handcraft.tsx.

reachFor: Every preset: SectionShell/SectionHead composition, MonoLabel, Ordinal
Texture DNA: Grain, Dots, CornerTicks, Sheen
avoid: Generic utility shells — keep constants opinionated (this is the design layer, not infrastructure)
inRepo: consumed by create-preset.py (always copies handcraft.tsx); governed by HANDCRAFT-CHECKLIST.md — tokens over hardcoded hex
